# Apex Packaging Solutions

Apex Packaging Solutions is a Canada-based custom packaging company providing custom boxes, rigid packaging, corrugated mailers, flexible pouches, paper bags and retail packaging for businesses across Canada, the United States and international markets. Through qualified overseas production facilities, Apex manages each project from structural design, artwork and sampling through production and doorstep delivery.

Location: 265 Brunswick Ave, London ON N6G 5P8, CANADA
Website: https://apexpackagingsolutions.com
Email: sales@apexpackagingsolutions.com
Phone: 905 595 1634
Languages served: English, French

## Products and services

- Folding cartons and custom retail boxes
- Corrugated shipping boxes and printed mailer boxes
- Rigid boxes, magnetic-closure boxes and presentation packaging
- Custom pouches, Mylar bags and polybags
- Paper shopping bags
- Food, bakery, pastry, cake and confectionery boxes
- Window boxes, sleeves, trays, dividers and inserts
- Custom printing, foil, embossing, spot UV, lamination and other premium finishes
- Industrial and bulk packaging
- Protective packaging, foam, void fill and VCI options
- Structural design, dielines, artwork preparation, proofs and sample coordination

## Project workflow

Apex manages packaging projects from the initial specification through structural design, artwork, sampling, production, quality coordination, freight and doorstep delivery. Approved projects are manufactured through qualified overseas production facilities.

Product availability, minimum order quantity, production time and shipping time vary according to the packaging style, dimensions, material, printing method, quantity, approvals and delivery destination. Contact Apex for a product-specific quotation.

## Industries served

- Retail and consumer products
- E-commerce and subscription brands
- Food, bakery and confectionery
- Automotive and industrial parts
- Electronics and technology
- Cosmetics, health and pharmaceutical programs
- Wholesale, distribution and multi-location operations

## Areas served

Apex serves businesses across Canada, the United States and international markets. Shipping method, freight cost, duties and delivery timing are confirmed for each destination and project.

## How to request a quote

Send the packaging type, dimensions, material requirements, printing and finishing scope, quantity, artwork status, delivery destination and required delivery date. Apex will review the specification and provide a product-specific quotation.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is the minimum order quantity?
Minimum order quantities vary by packaging style, size, material, printing method, quantity and delivery destination. Contact Apex for a product-specific quotation.

### What is the typical production and shipping time?
Production and shipping timelines vary by packaging style, dimensions, material, printing method, quantity, approvals and delivery destination. Apex confirms timing in each product-specific quotation.

### Where are Apex packaging products manufactured?
Approved projects are manufactured through qualified overseas production facilities. Apex coordinates structural design, artwork, sampling, production, quality review, freight and delivery.

### Where does Apex deliver?
Apex serves businesses across Canada, the United States and international markets.

### Can Apex support custom artwork and structures?
Yes. Apex coordinates structural design, dielines, artwork preparation, proofs, samples, printing and premium finishing according to the project requirements.
